# Disney Story Collection Book and Audio CD Set

## Immerse Your Child in Classic Disney Magic

Bring home the ultimate literary and auditory experience with this enchanting **Disney story book set (Book + CD)** from Litera. This collection is a must-have for any young reader, offering beloved Disney classics combined with high-quality audio storytelling. For the first time, beautiful illustrated books based on celebrated Disney films are paired with accompanying audio CDs, creating a comprehensive and magical learning experience.

Children can enjoy following over 100 gorgeous illustrations while simultaneously listening to timeless stories. The set features iconic animated adventures, including **Snow White**, **Cinderella**, and **The Jungle Book**, alongside modern narratives from Pixar's animation studios. All the tales are brought to life with the recognizable and captivating voice of the renowned actress Stela Popescu.
